jobs.description: Amazon's Delivery Service Partner (DSP) program is the backbone of last-mile delivery - thousands of independent small businesses that hire drivers, operate Amazon-branded vans and deliver millions of packages every day across North America, Europe and the rest of the world. Within WW DSP's multi-billion-dollar cost base, the largest and most control-sensitive flow is what Amazon pays its DSPs - fixed, variable, incentive and exception payments, all governed by rate cards set by the DSP Pricing team. The Senior Financial Analyst will serve as the dedicated Finance partner to the WW DSP Payments and Pricing teams within the WW DSP Finance Central Team, reporting to the Senior Finance Manager, and will own two interconnected mandates. On payments, the role owns end-to-end DSP payment controllership across North America (Monthly fixed payments, plus weekly variable, FMP, Walker, incentive, dispute and exception payments) together with the GRC controls and Internal Audit action items that sit on top of them - evolving DSP Finance from transactional approver to SME mechanism owner under the risk-tiered DSP Payments Controls Framework, and scaling that model to WW parity across EU and ROW. On pricing, the role establishes Finance as the governance and analytical partner to the Pricing team - building the rate card audit framework, embedding Finance checkpoints before rate changes are implemented, shaping PRICE tool controllership design, and bridging Pricing and Payments so disconnects are caught before they become payment defects. Both mandates run on an AI-first operating model: extending AI-driven validation agents from weekly variable payments to every recurring control and into EU and ROW, so Finance time shifts from manual approval to exception management, root-cause resolution and strategic partnership. This is a high-impact, cross-functional role for a Finance professional who combines strong controllership instincts and sound judgement on high-dollar decisions with the ability to influence Payments Product, Payment Ops, Pricing, Trans CS and Internal Audit stakeholders - and who operates with equal confidence at the transaction level and in front of senior leadership. Key job responsibilities - Own end-to-end payments controllership for WW DSP - approving weekly variable (NA and EU), FMP, Walker, incentive, dispute and exception payments under the risk-tiered DSP Payments Controls Framework, operating as total process owner and governance auditor, and running the 15-20% governance audit of Payment Ops checks and quarterly Finance attestation. - Own the payments controls, audit and governance agenda - GRC Rate Validation as quarterly control owner, Fixed and Variable Payments Internal Audit action items, payment policy formalization (FMP, Variable, Bulk Upload), and authoring the WW RMP Approval Threshold Framework with per-country thresholds and tech build partnership. - Serve as the dedicated Finance partner to the Pricing workstream - building the NA rate card audit framework and extending it WW, establishing Finance review checkpoints in the pricing change process, engaging with the PRICE tool on controllership design, building rate card effectiveness reporting and planning-cycle scenario modelling, and managing the FMP payment cycle end-to-end from VPA run through rate card approval to execution. - Drive WW parity in payments and pricing controllership - consolidating all payment lines across NA and EU under DSP Finance, approving EU weekly variable payments across nine countries, closing EU bulk-payment controllership gaps with maker-checker controls and SOPs, laying the EU / ROW pricing governance groundwork, and owning the parity roadmap with milestones per geography. - Lead AI-first automation, reporting and cost-out for the payments and pricing space - extending Orcha/AI validation agents to every recurring control, training Payment Ops on agent-driven checks, contributing Finance inputs to VPA 2.0, Shield anomaly detection and the Dispute Reduction Framework, publishing the weekly payments controllership flash and Payments MBR metrics, and identifying validated cost avoidance and savings for the DSP Cost-Out MBR. A day in the life - Reviews the week's variable payment runs and pending FMP, Walker and exception payments - validating against rate cards and agent-driven checks, approving what passes, and working high-dollar disputes through the tiered framework with root-cause evidence - Partners cross-functionally with Pricing, Payment Ops, Trans CS and CO India - auditing rate-in-system against approved rates, ensuring Finance checkpoints are met before rate changes land, and tracing payment defects back to their upstream pricing or process cause - Owns controllership narratives for leadership - translating exception trends, audit findings and automation progress into the weekly payments flash, bi-weekly leadership updates, GRC evidence packages and Internal Audit responses - Advances WW parity and automation - onboarding the next EU or ROW payment line into the DSP Finance validation framework, extending an Orcha validation agent to a new control, and documenting the SOP so the process scales without adding manual effort About the team Our team is committed to delivering accurate, timely financial insights that help Amazon make smarter decisions. We value collaboration, continuous improvement, and a culture where every team member is encouraged to ask questions and challenge assumptions. As we look ahead, we are focused on expanding our analytical capabilities and building scalable tools that drive efficiency. If you are curious, resourceful, and excited about growing your career in finance at one of the world's most innovative companies, we would love to hear from you.

jobs.description: About Amazon Ads Amazon Ads is the digital advertising arm of Amazon and one of our fastest growing businesses. We operate at the intersection of commerce, entertainment and advertising. Amazon Ads offers unique advertising products, enterprise ad tech and a rich array of unique creative, format and measurement solutions. We believe that advertising, when done well, can connect the right brands with the right consumers while delivering holistic value. Twitch is the world's leading live-streaming platform, home to a highly engaged, hard-to-reach audience that spends billions of minutes each month watching gaming, entertainment, sports, music and creator-led content. As Twitch continues to scale its advertising proposition across EMEA, the ability to articulate the unique value of Twitch audiences to advertisers is a critical growth lever - and a capability we are building from the ground up. This is an individual contributor role embedded within the Twitch Go-to-Market (GTM) team who will focus on Insights and Measurement. You will work extensively with the Twitch sales specialists, GTM leads, product and ad-tech teams to develop and deliver insights that directly fuel revenue growth. This is not a backend role. You will actively participate in customer meetings as the subject matter expert on Twitch audience insights & measurement, and leverage Amazon's rich array of insights and measurement solutions - combined with Twitch-native data - to deliver media strategies that position Twitch as an essential part of the advertising mix. Key job responsibilities - Build the Twitch insights playbook from scratch: Develop a scalable library of Twitch audience insights, competitive benchmarks and measurement case studies that the sales team can deploy across pitches, QBRs and strategic conversations. - Equip the sales team to sell with confidence: Translate complex Twitch audience data (viewership, engagement, demographics, content affinities) into clear, compelling narratives that articulate the unique and incremental value of Twitch to advertisers. - Establish and advance senior-level relationships: Build relationships with senior marketing decision makers (e.g. Senior Director, C-level) by positioning yourself as the go-to expert on Twitch audience intelligence and at least one advanced analytical area of advertising. - Generate data-driven insights: Leverage Amazon's proprietary data, Twitch-native signals, third-party research and ad measurement solutions to generate actionable insights that prove the impact of advertising on Twitch. - Develop Twitch measurement expertise: Develop expertise in Twitch-specific metrics and Amazon's proprietary measurement tools, working to constantly evolve how we analyse and communicate the value of Twitch audiences to advertisers. - Directly support revenue growth: Partner with GTM and sales leadership to identify the highest-impact insight gaps, prioritise your roadmap accordingly, and measure your work against pipeline and revenue outcomes. - Advocate for data-driven decision-making: Guide advertisers to implement recommended solutions, with a particular focus on demonstrating Twitch's role in full-funnel and cross-platform strategies. - Influence product and go-to-market strategy: Write internal documents with strategic recommendations that influence the direction of Twitch advertising products, measurement capabilities and go-to-market working mechanisms with internal stakeholders. - Scale your analyses: Actively scale your analyses to other categories or locales through AI-native solutions. A day in the life No two days at Amazon are the same. You will have the flexibility to work with your stakeholders and define a book of business that will maximise your impact on Twitch revenue. On any given day, you might find yourself: - Building a bespoke audience profile to help a seller win a competitive brief in colaboration with our Audience&Insights organization - Presenting Twitch viewership insights at a sales-led event or advertiser summit - Partnering with the GTM team to shape the narrative for a tentpole moment like TwitchCon - Running an intricate analysis to influence a key advertiser decision - Working with the product/engineering team to pilot a new measurement solution tailored to live-streaming environments - Collaborating with the A&I team to bring methodological rigour to a Twitch-specific research project About the team Twitch GTM team - a small, high-impact squad responsible for equipping Twitch-dedicated sellers across EU5 with the strategies, tools and narratives they need to hit ambitious growth targets. You will also work closely with the Analytics & Insights (A&I) team within Amazon Ads, a sales enablement group responsible for developing actionable and innovative insights that prove the value of Amazon Ads to advertisers and partners. Your unique position bridging both teams means you will bring the rigour and methodology of A&I together with the commercial urgency and customer proximity of GTM - a combination that is essential to closing the insights gap and unlocking Twitch's revenue potential.

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. As part of our growing Data Science and Analytics team, you will play an instrumental role in our company’s mission of building safe and beneficial artificial intelligence by driving data-informed decision making across our organization. Highly effective written communication and presentation skills
A track record of translating complex data into clear, actionable insights for both technical and business stakeholders
A bias for action and ability to thrive in ambiguous, fast-moving environments where you must create clarity and drive forward progress
